results.name: The water is a transparent, tinted material with no depth write
The water shader compiled without errors
The scene is mirrored into a render target about half the screen size
The reflection has real content (not a blank texture)
The lakebed is 1.4 m deep in the middle and dry well away from the lake
Depth grows steadily from the bank to the middle
The sampled depth matches the real terrain to within 4 cm at 300 random points
A ripple is stored with its position, start time and strength
Only 12 ripples can be alive at once; the oldest are replaced
Ripples fade out after four seconds
Reeds, cattails, lily pads, flowers and lakebed weeds are all planted
There are three ducks and three dragonflies
The reeds sway in the wind
A rowboat floats at its mooring in water deep enough for it
The boat is solid: nobody can stand inside it
Nothing grows through the boat
Lily pads float on the surface and reeds stand at the water's edge
In a minute of swimming the ducks never touch the bank or leave the lake
A person walking up to a duck makes it swim away
Someone standing still at a distance does not scare them
Dragonflies hover and dart above the water and the bank
results.detail: between 0.40 and 1.17 m above the surface

results.name: A fish leaps now and then when you are nearby, and splashes
...and is gone again afterwards
Wading in makes ripples around you
...and a splash sound
...and spray
Standing still in the water makes no ripples of its own
Driving through the water leaves a wake of ripples
...and splashes
A shot that crosses the lake surface reports the point where it enters
A shot over dry land does not splash
A shot that points up does not splash
A shot that hits something nearer than the water does not splash
A rifle shot into the lake lands as a splash at the surface
A body thrown into the lake splashes on the surface
...and floats there rather than sinking to the bed
The boat has four collision circles lined up along its hull (not across it)
...and they are never mistaken for drivable stones
Walking straight at the bow stops you short of the boat
Walking straight at the stern stops you short of the boat
The Jeep stops against the boat instead of riding over it
results.detail: stopped at x -9.5, body rose 0.12 m

results.name: A duck is solid: standing on one pushes you out of it
Driving into a duck sends it flapping into the air
...with a honk and a cloud of feathers
...and the Jeep carries on (a duck does not stop it)
The duck lands again on the water, somewhere else on the lake
A Jeep passing well clear does not make a duck fly, only swim away
At 60 fps the mirror stays at full quality
A second of slow frames is not enough to change anything
About 2.5 s of slow frames shrink the mirror one step
...and another 2.5 s shrinks it again
At the last step the mirror is switched off in favour of a sky tint
A long gap (lake out of view) is not counted as a slow frame
With the mirror off the water still renders (no errors)
Reset leaves the spring in place
